prompts.terrain: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: supplied Miami coastline campaign land plate. Maintain its shape, pixel-art style, isometric overhead camera, turquoise surf on right, palm trees, northern small Miami district, and northbound asphalt highway. CHANGE THE SOUTHERN THIRD: remove ALL military compound buildings, hangars, runway, jets, tanks, concrete walls, gates and antenna. Replace their entire footprint with low open coastal GRASS and pale sandy patches, a few scattered palms at edges and a little end of the existing highway. Make two spacious uncluttered grass clearings: one lower/southeast where compound was, one above-left where exit gate was. These are backgrounds for TWO SEPARATELY DRAWN FLOATING LEVEL ICONS, so no new landmarks or platforms baked into clearings. Continue the road between these clearings and up toward the north. Remove any other large military ruins baked into the interior grass. Preserve other geographic features and sparse violet symbiote growth at distant edges. Add a short northwest-facing asphalt road spur leaving the upper-left edge of the northern small Miami neighborhood, to receive a separate bridge. Do NOT include the bridge yet. Preserve genuine alpha transparency around the landplate, full silhouette with margin. No text, numbers, flags, UI, route lines or drawn shadows. Keep 16-bit pixel clusters and dark outlines. Do not repaint the scene into a different style.
prompts.islands: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a sprite ASSET SHEET of FIVE individually isolated southern tropical islands for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE's campaign map. Reference is for the exact rich 16-bit pixel-art miniature isometric map treatment. THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS with large transparent gutters, same-size 512x512 cells, each island entirely confined to its own cell with 12% margin. Sixth bottom-right cell EMPTY/transparent. No drawn grid, text, labels, numbers, routes, flags, clouds, boats or connecting land. Each island is a separate complete closed silhouette on genuine alpha, tiny turquoise surf rim allowed but no rectangular sea background. TOP LEFT small curved beach/palm islet with pale sand; TOP MIDDLE low rocky island with dense palms and a turquoise enclosed lagoon; TOP RIGHT scrub-grass limestone island with broken stone ruins. BOTTOM LEFT grassy crescent island with little sandy cove. BOTTOM MIDDLE the CENTRAL PLATEAU: broad flat grassy top on tall steep stepped tan/gray rock cliffs, a few short palms on sides, an open empty summit, squat mesa island silhouette distinctly higher than others. No temple or building on summit. All original, sharp clustered pixels, near-black outlines, muted green palms, sand, layered stone. Isometric view identical across all five. Four surrounding islands and the plateau must remain unconnected so we can arrange them independently.
prompts.objects: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent sprite asset sheet of NINE individually isolated AMBIENT MAP OBJECTS for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE's tropical Miami campaign map, matching reference island's detailed 16-bit pixel-art treatment. Strict THREE COLUMNS x THREE ROWS equal cells, generous 20% transparent gutters, each entire object centered within its cell. No object touches another, no scenery, no labels, no text, no grid, no UI. Genuine alpha background. Row1: three distinct cool CLOUD sprites—left elongated white cumulus bank with pale blue-gray underside, middle compact billowing white cumulus cluster, right dark stormcloud bank with violet inner shade but no lightning bolt outside cloud. Pixel clusters, hard-edged stepped silhouette, no fuzzy alpha halo. Row2: three BOATS at high overhead view all facing up/NORTH—left compact white civilian motorboat teal windscreen, middle weathered military patrol boat dark green steel, right small rust-and-blue cargo boat with two boxy cargo containers. Include tiny attached white V wakes behind stern only. Row3: three ALIEN DRONES high overhead all facing up/NORTH—left small sharp crescent scout, middle heavier three-pronged hovering drone, right biomechanical manta drone. Black charcoal alien metallic carapaces, violet symbiote veins, little cyan/violet engine accents, strong silhouettes. No pilots or faces. Use illustrated 16-bit arcade pixels consistent with map, readable small. These are individual map decorations for animated travel and circling behavior, not a flattened scene.
prompts.city: Use case: stylized-concept. One LARGE MAJOR CITY landplate for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE campaign map. Reference establishes the coastal 16-bit pixel art and isometric miniature perspective. Separate transparent region, roughly wide 5:4. Dense Miami-inspired metropolitan city, a much larger and more imposing destination than the small neighborhood in reference: clusters of cream and blue-glass skyscrapers and stepped coral/teal Art Deco midrises, grid of asphalt streets with palms, squat parking structures and industrial harbor edge. Make the central skyline readable, varied building heights, intricate pixels, dark outlines, controlled highlights. Low irregular grass/sand/rock peninsula foundation, continuous defined perimeter, genuine alpha around it, narrow turquoise surf at low right edge. This city lies NORTHWEST of the coastal region. Therefore a broad highway must run visibly out of the city to a bridge landing on its LOWER RIGHT/SOUTHEAST edge; stop at the landing, no full bridge yet. No enormous mountains, no futuristic floating spaceship city, no labels/numbers/flags/UI. Very sparse violet symbiote growth at outer industrial edges shows alien spread, still recognizably Florida city. Buildings and streets original. All edges within frame with padding.
prompts.bridge: Use case: stylized-concept. One separate transparent MODULAR BRIDGE map object for BULLETS OF FURY OVERDRIVE, matching the supplied city/coast references' 16-bit pixel-art isometric miniature map perspective. A long low concrete coastal causeway bridge across water, connects LOWER RIGHT/SOUTHEAST endpoint to UPPER LEFT/NORTHWEST endpoint. Entire bridge visible on one diagonal from bottom-right toward top-left. Two-lane asphalt road, crisp white/yellow lane marks, guard rails, repeated concrete support piers visible below, small central raised span with elegant structural supports. Both end abutments include only tiny grassy concrete landing tabs for overlapping landplates. No large islands attached. Transparent empty air/water around and under bridge, no ocean rectangle, no sky, no cars/boats/characters, no labels/text/flags/UI. Do not create a left-to-right horizontal bridge. Carefully preserve southeast-to-northwest diagonal needed to join the two existing region objects. Complete unclipped silhouette, wide transparent padding.
